exposure: Schizophrenia with deficit (SCZ-D) vs. schizophrenia without deficit (SCZ-ND)
history of schizophrenia in first-degree relatives
childhood trauma (emotional abuse, emotional neglect, physical abuse and sexual abuse)
History of childhood trauma (emotional abuse, emotional neglect, physical abuse, and sexual abuse)
finding: The study found that male sex, birth weight <3000g, and history of childhood trauma were associated with SCZ-D, while substance abuse (excluding nicotine) at psychosis onset was associated with SCZ-ND.
mod_finding: This study did not find a statistically significant association between mode of delivery and deficit or non-deficit schizophrenia, although it did note that individuals with deficit schizophrenia had higher rates of birth weight below 3000g.
